name: Crayfish, prawns and aquatic insects
description: Freshwater crayfish, grass prawns and aquatic insects. Functional group pooling the source's crayfish, prawn and aquatic insect compartments, aggregated because all are small swimming/crawling invertebrates of the marsh. The key middle link of the wet-season web: they graze periphyton and detritus and are eaten by fishes, amphibians, turtles, alligators, wading birds, otters and raccoons.
